'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Robert J Johnson LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Robert J Johnson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Sweeney Todd's D.H.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Robert J Johnson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
